body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills seat (seat 1, `domain:skills#1`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Body **r130**, written 2026-10-02T21:11Z by `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ` (os-elon-musk) at 收班 on the maintainer's word 「当前任务处理完就下班」: the seat is vacant, two Tier H PRs are left on watch. r129 (standby after wave 7) and earlier revisions are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated; carried lists stay carried BY REFERENCE.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** · former: `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ` (os-elon-musk), seated 2026-10-01T23:30Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills` as seat 1, stood down 2026-10-02T21:11Z. Patrol Routine `trig_01WFQtjRgmMXutRBsd7CAJyd` deleted at 收班; no seat Routine is live. 留守 (the departing session, named items only): PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11480 and PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11507 stay subscribed by `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`, which lands and closes them out on approval; it reads no queue and dispatches nothing. Hand-over: `/pm-dispatch skills` + read this post, then objectstack-ai/objectui#11311 (the lane's objectui board, same seat); the release marker is the 收班简报 comment below this body.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Queue snapshot (2026-10-02T21:11Z, `pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`): objectstack 1 — #21465** (p3 `bug` `tooling` `area:devpath`, graded 2026-10-02T20:54Z: `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs` T2 reads a multi-line import list as a closed set; un-dispatched — the stand-down order came first; the next seat's first pick). **objectui 0.**
- **In the landing window (ACCEPTed, Tier H `skills/**`, awaiting an APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`; both green and mergeable):** PR objectui#11480 (objectui#11471, `rules/protocol.md`'s `BreakpointColumnMap` parenthetical, head `1078b79c`, four-piece on since 2026-10-02T15:58Z) · PR objectui#11507 (objectui#11503, `guides/project-setup.md`'s CLI table: the `objectui add` row deleted, `analyze` reworded, head `6604f48f`, four-piece on since 2026-10-02T20:53Z). After an approval: clear `needs-user-decision` → relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` (unless the approver already did) → confirm MERGED on objectui `origin/main` by content → strip `pm:dispatched` + assignee from the card, drop the PR's stale `needs-user-decision`, landing note. Triage's proposal to fold the two into one PR was declined (reason on objectui#11503's claim 5960912895; the gap is #21467).
- **Landed this shift: 15 PRs, 14 cards closed out** — objectstack PR #21269 · #21271 · #21278 · #21291 · #21283 · #21298 · #21302 + #21303 · #21312 · #21343 · #21402; objectui PR #11410 · #11418 · #11419 · #11427 (cards, heads and notes enumerated in r129). Every Tier H PR (eight) was approved and readied / enqueued by os-zhuang himself.
- **Decision box (this lane): 0.** **Blocked:** #18290 (`Blocked-by: #18471`, still open) · #21415 (p2, `Blocked-by: #20274`; objectstack-ai's Common Pitfalls line on `memory` goes stale when PR #21413 lands — the unlock scan places it back). **Findings bare:** #13562 (metadata, `status:parked`, not this lane's) · #21467 (filed at 收班 by this seat: the fold / un-carded-pass gap — the skills seat grades it).
- **Cross-lane memos:** objectui#11500 (`domain:ui`, now dispatched by that seat) retires `create plugin` / `lint` / `test` / `studio`; when it lands, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`'s CLI table owes the same pass — a card, not a bare grep (#21467). Watch items #20809 and #20887 closed 2026-10-01 (PR #21021 / PR #21170 merged): the next seat checks once whether `skills/objectstack-upgrade` (the retirement kit's `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` wording) and `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (its analytics line) now owe a sentence; this seat did not. #21295 (`check:pm-issue-transfer` wiring) closed in the spec lane.
- **Cross-lane declaration received (knock 5955822785, 2026-10-02T15:36Z, `domain:services` seat 2, seat post #21118):** #21329 (ruled A′, director batch #268) is dispatched with one governed cross-lane surface, `docs/adr/0111-record-share-management-authority-and-verb-boundary.md` (D8 rule 1 restated), in PR #21447 — Tier H, held for the maintainer's own approval with that seat's final 维护者速读 and both approvers requested; no `skills/**` file in it. ⛔ Not a request for work; an objection would go on #21329 before approval. This seat read it at 收班 and raises none; the next seat owes nothing on it beyond awareness.
- **Filed this shift (all graded or closed since, except the last):** #21294 (landed as PR #21312) · #21295 (spec lane, closed) · objectui#11414 (landed as PR objectui#11418) · #21467 (bare, at 收班).
- **Premise corrections on record** (claim / ACCEPT ids in r129): #21048 · #21011 · objectui#11414 · #21107 · #21288.

## Hot-file serial queue

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`: FREE (PR #21205 merged). `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6). Every other file of the lane on this board: FREE. objectui: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → PR objectui#11480 and `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` → PR objectui#11507, both this seat's, in the landing window (objectstack-ai/objectui#11311).

## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (all accept `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui`); a body refresh needs `--ack-through=ID`. Route this shift: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`).
- **Landing.** Tier H = an authorized APPROVED review, then the seat clears `needs-user-decision` and lands (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`), unless the approver already did; Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier review PASS then the seat lands; non-governed = CI + the seat's read. Landing = MERGED through the queue (`added_to_merge_queue` on the timeline, then MERGED confirmed by content on `origin/main`). `Fixes #N` closed the card on every one of this shift's 15 queue merges.
- **Sister-repo claims.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments; the recogniser accepts `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with `MANDATORY` cited on the same line — used on every objectui claim this shift.
- **Platform readings (for the next seat):** ① `write-pace` (40 writes / trailing hour) is per container token and SHARED by the seat and every dev it runs; with 3 devs in flight the budget binds (exit 10 = refused, nothing written; the tool prints the reopen instant). ② `post-stamped` refuses a bare `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` quoted from a brief unless wrapped as a declared reading (MIXED, exit 2); flags take the `=` form. ③ Container Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom@30's `^22.22.2` floor under objectui's `engine-strict` — devs install with `--config.engine-strict=false` (deviation recorded each time). ④ Inside a subagent, the auto-mode permission classifier refused a dev's `label-write` stroke on PR #21283 and PR #21402 and one `gh api … GET`; nothing was written; the seat does not perform a refused dev write on the dev's behalf — it surfaces it. Both PRs merged regardless (`Check Changeset` is not required in the merge group); the two objectui devs of waves 8–9 saw no refusal. ⑤ The container cannot read a fleet-write run's job log (302 → blob, CONNECT 403) or `output.summary`; annotations are readable — #21294 → PR #21312, and the **first live reading is in**: `issue-create.mjs` took #21467's number from run 37064349969's annotation (「the platform's own answer」), no list fallback. ⑥ A cloud session reads only repositories attached to it; the GitHub search API is unavailable (repo-scoped endpoints only), so dedupe runs over repo-scoped lists. ⑦ `post-stamped` refuses a `## Contract review` whose `Local-runs:` line is outside the closed set `none` / `probe — REASON`. ⑧ `fleet-write` validate refuses an actions file packed as an object rather than a bare array (zero writes; the dev repacked) — the guard works as documented.
- **Checkout**: `/home/user/objectstack` and `/home/user/objectui` were fast-forwarded to `origin/main` on every patrol; the mirror branch `claude/zealous-tesla-zsd0xu` on both carries no seat content.
